{
  "mode": "CUSTOM",
  "instruction": "Generate meaningful, concise commit messages using Conventional Commits.

Format:
<type>: <short imperative summary>

Use one of these types:
feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, build, ci

Rules:
- Keep the subject under 72 characters when practical.
- Use imperative mood, e.g. "document safe update flow".
- Mention the actual user-visible or maintenance impact.
- Avoid vague summaries like "update files", "changes", or "fix stuff".
- Avoid overly verbose descriptions or unnecessary details.
- Add a short body only when the reason, migration impact, or config/systemd impact is not obvious.
- If config, install, update, or systemd behavior changes, mention that explicitly."
}
